name: Abyss Theme
overview: [PREVIEW] Complete Abyss theme with Spotlight, Lite mode and configurable appearance.
description: [PREVIEW] Abyss by Om Gupta (AumGupta), MIT: https://github.com/AumGupta/abyss-jellyfin. Includes configurable Spotlight, Lite mode, colors/fonts/effects, reversible Web layout, safe dashboard palette, plugin CSS adaptations, optional visual/code updates and rollback. Requires Jellyfin 12.3, File Transformation 3.x and compatible server-hosted Web. Native clients and real adaptation-plugin installations remain unverified.

versions.changelog: [PREVIEW] Add configurable Spotlight and Lite mode, a redesigned configuration UI with appearance preview, colors/fonts/effects, reversible Dark/backdrops/home order, guarded dashboard styling, separate visual/code updates and recovery. Tested with real Jellyfin Web and restricted-account isolation. Requires Jellyfin 12.3 and File Transformation 3.x; native clients and real adaptation-plugin installations remain unverified.

[PREVIEW] Persistent Abyss CSS by Om Gupta (AumGupta), with optional upstream updates, rollback and separate Jellyfin Enhanced/Media Bar Enhanced adaptations. Requires Jellyfin 12.3 and File Transformation 3.x. Verified with real server-hosted Web; native clients and real installations of the adapted plugins remain unverified.

name: Theme Song Volume
overview: [PREVIEW] Keep library theme songs at a comfortable volume.
description: [PREVIEW] Set a default theme-song volume and individual song overrides without changing source files or normal playback volume. Settings follow your Jellyfin account. Requires File Transformation 3.x and a compatible server-hosted Jellyfin Web client.

versions.changelog: [PREVIEW] Global volume and confirmed reset now live in Account settings > Display. Library pages show one title override slider and Use global, with automatic override selection and inherited slider updates. Adds theme-aware, touch-sized controls. Android/device playback limits remain unchanged.

[PREVIEW] Add a scoped JMP 1.12.0 MPV theme-volume adapter, refresh cached web hooks on upgrades, and allow account settings edits on unsupported players. Native commands are tested against the official JMP class with a simulated bridge; actual Windows sound output and Android playback remain unverified.

[PREVIEW] Fix empty theme-volume controls on Jellyfin Media Player's Chromium 83 engine and remove listeners explicitly on uninstall. Verified against actual Qt WebEngine 5.15.2. Native playback remains unsupported.

[PREVIEW] Fix the audio hook in official Jellyfin Web bundles and settings authentication. Verified with real Jellyfin 12.3.0, File Transformation 3.0.2.0, and Windows Chrome, including playback and uninstall. Native Windows/Android playback remains unsupported.

[PREVIEW] Keep the web integration alive during Jellyfin page navigation and fix settings JSON field names. Tested with the reported Ultrachromic CSS modules. Requires Jellyfin 12.3 and File Transformation 3.x; native playback remains unsupported.

[PREVIEW] Fix missing theme-volume controls on Jellyfin Web 12.3 detail pages and share File Transformation's index.html pipeline with other UI plugins. Requires Jellyfin 12.3 and File Transformation 3.x.
[PREVIEW] Fix plugin discovery and GET /Plugins failing in BasePlugin.get_CanUninstall(). Requires Jellyfin 12.3 and File Transformation 3.x.
[PREVIEW] Initial release for testing. Requires Jellyfin 12.3 and File Transformation 3.x. Native client support is not guaranteed.
